messages:
Mia San: Heads-up — AcmeCorp sent back the SIG spreadsheet. They flagged Q3.2 (tenant isolation) and Q7.1 (KMS / key rotation). Need owners and evidence for a Friday POC kickoff. @Jasper Li @Ravi Patel can you grab artifacts?

Jasper Li: On it. I can provide network diagrams, KMS integration note, and an anonymized rotation log. Will upload to s3 and link here.

Ravi Patel: I will extract the runtime config showing dedicated vs hosted isolation modes and a snippet for VPC-only deployments. Also can pull VPC Flow logs and a recent deploy audit.

Mia San: Thanks. Customer asked if we can return the spreadsheet by EOD Thu — is that realistic? Also they want an explanation of how our Dedicated pools enforce tenant separation.

Alex Nguyen: From Acme side: EOD Thu would be ideal. POC kickoff Friday morning. They also specifically asked for HSM/KMS details and proof of rotation.

Jasper Li: We have a partner HSM integration — I'll link the architecture and the KMS controls doc. Evidence paths: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/acme-sig/kms-architecture.pdf and s3://redwood-sec-evidence/acme-sig/kms-rotation-sample.txt. Control reference ENC-02 covers rotation policy.

Ravi Patel: Runtime snippet to paste into the SIG answer: `network_mode: vpc-isolated
isolation_type: dedicated-pool
allowed_accounts: ["acct-1234"]
kv_cache: disabled_for_shared_tenants` — that plus the network diagram should satisfy 3.2. I'll also export a short paragraph describing how we bind GPUs to tenant pools and prevent cross-tenant memory sharing.

Mia San: Perfect. Quick check — do we have a formal key rotation policy doc link I can point to? Jasper?

Jasper Li: Yes: https://internal.redwood/security/key-rotation-v2 (shared-read). For the SIG I'll attach the policy page and an anonymized rotation log sample. Marking Q7.1 as ENC-02 + evidence attached.

sig-bot: Reminder set: SIG return deadline 2026-03-26 09:00 UTC

Mia San: Cool — I'll consolidate answers into the spreadsheet and do one pass for tone. Ownership: Jasper = KMS & rotation logs, Ravi = tenant isolation artifacts & VPC flow logs, Mia = finalize spreadsheet + upload to GDrive + notify Acme. Ping here if anything missing; I'll post the GDrive link once uploaded. :thumbsup:
